description.value: Burnaby Palace Restaurant is a long-established Chinese restaurant that has been serving the Burnaby community for over 25 years, specializing in Cantonese and Szechuan cuisine. It is known for its modern take on classic dishes — particularly the ginger beef and spicy wontons — using fresh, high-quality ingredients. Dine-in, takeout, and local delivery are all available, making it a flexible meal stop in the Boundary Road area.
